definitions.gloss: worship hall; hall of worship; oratory
definitions.explanation: The main hall of a Shinto shrine where visitors pray and make offerings. It stands in front of the main sanctuary and is the building that most visitors interact with — the place where you throw coins, clap your hands, and bow in prayer.

examples.english: To put one's hands together in prayer before the worship hall.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{拝殿|はいでん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{建|た}てられた→建てる：01189_tateru⟧。
examples.english: This shrine's worship hall was built in the Edo period.

examples.japanese: {初詣|はつもうで}で{拝殿|はいでん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かう→向かう：01186_mukau⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できていた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A long line of people had formed heading toward the worship hall for the New Year's first shrine visit.

notes:
Compound of {拝|はい} ('to worship; to pray') and {殿|でん} ('hall; palace'). In Shinto shrine architecture, the {拝殿|はいでん} is the public-facing building where worshippers pray. It is distinct from the ⟦{本殿|ほんでん}→本殿：13090_honden⟧ (main sanctuary), which houses the enshrined deity and is usually off-limits to the public.

SHRINE ARCHITECTURE:
- The typical layout places the {拝殿|はいでん} in front, connected or adjacent to the ⟦{本殿|ほんでん}→本殿：13090_honden⟧ behind it
- Not all shrines have a separate {拝殿|はいでん} — smaller shrines may have only a ⟦{本殿|ほんでん}→本殿：13090_honden⟧
- The {拝殿|はいでん} often features a ⟦{賽銭箱|さいせんばこ}→賽銭箱：24468_saisenbako⟧ (offering box) and ⟦{鈴|すず}→鈴：03890_suzu⟧ (bell) at its front

- {拝殿|はいでん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{参拝|さんぱい}する→参拝する：15627_sanpaisuru⟧: to worship at the hall of worship
- {拝殿|はいでん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧: in front of the worship hall
- {拝殿|はいでん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かって→向かう：01186_mukau⟧⟦{礼|れい}→礼：02170_rei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to bow toward the worship hall
- {拝殿|はいでん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建|た}て{替|か}え→建て替え：19739_tatekae⟧: rebuilding of the worship hall

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{本殿|ほんでん}→本殿：13090_honden⟧: main sanctuary — the innermost, most sacred building that houses the deity; usually not open to the public
- ⟦{社殿|しゃでん}→社殿：20755_shaden⟧: shrine buildings — a collective term for all the buildings in a shrine complex
- ⟦{本堂|ほんどう}→本堂：15935_hondou⟧: main hall (Buddhist) — the equivalent central worship building in a Buddhist temple
